date_scope_check.qualification_retained: ME038-R1: The contemporaneous SPA-based report specifies the policy taking effect at 23:55 on 7 March 2020, which takes priority over later rounding to 8 March. This dates the formal restriction, not a directly observed first barrier. The embassy statement reported on 23 July says Saudi citizens could return without prior permission from Wednesday 22 July, while another contemporary report dates the land reopening to Thursday 23 July; the endpoint remains bounded to those dates. Earlier humanitarian or specially authorised returns and commercial trucks are excluded. The 137–138 calendar-day policy span is not a continuous physical-closure duration or a September foreign-passenger endpoint.
